_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Not knowing how to start a new topic

segments.text: It means, I have one more thing to say.
By the way, I like your bag.
Repeat after me. By the way.

native.caption: Хотите перевести разговор на другую тему? Скажите “By the way”: это значит «кстати». Пример: “By the way, I like your bag.” Послушайте Карлоса, а в паузе повторите сами. Больше практики в приложении Lexkite.

en.hook: How do you say "kstati" in English?
en.caption: Want to move the talk to a new topic? Say “By the way”, which means by the way. Example: “By the way, I like your bag.” Listen to Carlos, then repeat in the pause. More practice is in the Lexkite app.
